debt.text: Halpin opposes privatizing Social Security and Medicare and pledges the benefits will be there for those who earned them.
debt.quote: if you play by the rules, those benefits will be there when you need them.

housing.text: Halpin says he wants to create more housing opportunities while preserving neighborhood character.
housing.quote: I believe we can create more housing opportunities without sacrificing the character of our neighborhoods.

safety.text: Halpin says he will fight to support police and combat fentanyl and human trafficking.
safety.quote: I'll fight to support our police, secure our borders, combat fentanyl and human trafficking

immigration.text: Halpin calls for an immigration system that is secure, orderly and fair, pairing border security with a path to citizenship.
immigration.quote: an immigration system that is secure, orderly, and fair.

health.text: Halpin says he supports building toward universal Medicare coverage while protecting the coverage people already have.
health.quote: I support building toward universal Medicare coverage in a way that protects the coverage people already have

energy.text: Halpin says he will make polluters pay and strengthen climate resilience while protecting clean water and air.
energy.quote: I'll continue fighting to make polluters pay, protect clean water and clean air, strengthen climate resilience

tax.text: On his official House site he says he is committed to lowering taxes for Long Islanders and small businesses and makes restoring the SALT deduction a top priority.
tax.quote: I am committed to lowering taxes for hardworking Long Islanders and small businesses.

safety.text: He states he opposes all efforts to defund the police and wants law enforcement to have the resources they need.
safety.quote: I vehemently oppose all efforts to defund the police.

immigration.text: He says the federal government must fully enforce immigration laws and secure the border, and he chairs the House Homeland Security Committee.
immigration.quote: the federal government has a responsibility to enforce our immigration laws, stop the flow of fentanyl and other deadly drugs

guns.text: He says he strongly supports the Second Amendment and opposes excessive firearm regulations, though he has voted for a universal background-checks bill.
guns.quote: I strongly support the Second Amendment. Law abiding Americans should be unencumbered by excessive regulations

energy.text: He backs an all-of-the-above strategy expanding American energy production while also, as a climate-caucus member, working to preserve clean energy tax incentives.
energy.quote: I support an all-of-the-above energy strategy that expands American energy production, strengthens our electric grid, and reduces our reliance on foreign adversaries.
